title: Rethinking Item Tokenization in Generative Recommenders: From Fixed Atoms to Semantic Subwords
abstract: arXiv:2608.22734v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In generative recommender systems, items are typically tokenized into fixed-length semantic ID sequences for autoregressive next-item prediction. However, for user-context modeling, this fine-grained representation triggers Intra-item Attention Overload: excessive attention is spent on low-level intra-item dependencies rather than high-level inter-item behavioral transitions.   To address this, we propose Semantic Subword Tokenization (SST), which represents historical items as variable-length semantic subwords while preserving fixed-length target decoding. SST first applies Item-level Subword Tokenization (IST) to merge stable adjacent atom tokens into compact semantic subword tokens, thereby reducing intra-item reassembly in the encoder. It then introduces Behavior-induced Co-occurrence Augmentation (BCA) to inject coarse-grained semantic prefix transition signals, guiding the freed modeling capacity toward inter-item behavioral regula

translated_title: 重新思考生成式推荐系统中的物品分词：从固定原子到语义子词
translated_abstract: 在生成式推荐系统中，物品通常被分词为固定长度的语义ID序列，用于自回归的下一项预测。然而，在用户上下文建模中，这种细粒度表示会引发物品内部注意力过载：过多注意力被消耗在低层级的物品内部依赖关系上，而非高层级的物品间行为转换。为解决这一问题，我们提出了语义子词分词（SST），它将历史物品表示为可变长度的语义子词，同时保持固定长度的目标解码。SST首先应用物品级子词分词（IST）将稳定的相邻原子标记合并为紧凑的语义子词标记，从而减少编码器中的物品内部重组。随后，它引入行为诱导的共现增强（BCA）来注入粗粒度的语义前缀转换信号，引导释放出的建模能力用于物品间的行为规律。
tldr: 该论文提出语义子词分词（SST）方法，通过合并物品内部原子为语义子词并注入行为共现信号，解决了生成式推荐系统中物品内部注意力过载问题，从而提升用户行为建模效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Semantic Subword Tokenization (SST), which merges intra-item atoms into semantic subwords and injects behavior co-occurrence signals to address intra-item attention overload in generative recommenders, thereby improving user behavior modeling efficiency.
